Human Resource Executive Job at Derive Communications Systems & Engineering Limited




        
    

        
        An Engineering company incorporated in 2010, located in Lagos and Abuja; with expertise in Building Services Solutions like electronic security systems, fire safety protection systems, IT and communications systems and automation systems is recruiting. An experienced Human Resource Executive needed to join our team.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resource Executive

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Ensuring company culture is reflected throughout the employee lifecycle, enforcing the organization’s culture and adherence to the company’s code of conduct and external policies; carry out periodic surveys for improvement and stay up to date with information and best practices in Human Capital Management and Labor Law.
	Manage the recruitment process, including candidate sourcing, reference checks, and onboarding.
	Schedule and coordinate meetings, interviews, and HR events.
	Maintain and update employee databases regularly.
	Set-up, preparation, feedback and documentation of performance review exercises and appraisals, and employee development and annual training programs; conduct orientations, facilitate trainings programs as at when required that will improve employee productivity
	Maintain employee records and ensure compliance with HR policies.
	Support performance management and training initiatives.
	Handle employee relations and workplace conflict resolution.
	Conduct performance reviews, management, and employee evaluations.
	Support payroll processing by ensuring employee records are accurate and up to date.
	Drafting and implementing HR policies and procedures.
	Manage employee engagement initiatives to promote a positive work environment.
	Maintain proper documentation and filing of HR-related records (both hard and soft copies).
	Coordinate employee exit processes, including exit interviews and clearance documentation.
	Maintain the work structure by conducting job analysis and updating job requirements for all positions to meet the requirements of the unit and achieve the objective of the organization
	Perform other role-related duties as may be assigned by the company.


Requirements


	Candidates should possess an HND with 2-4 years of work experience.


Method of Application 

Interested and qualified candidates should forward their updated curriculum vitae and a one-page cover letter in a single document to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

Note: 


	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and should be ready for immediate interview.
	For more enquiries, contact: 09113374830

	We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Personal Assistant (Lifestyle &amp; Family Assistant) to provide comprehensive personal support to a busy executive in the fitness and wellness industry.

Personal &amp; Lifestyle Management:


	Manage the executive&#39;s personal calendar, appointments, and non-business commitments.
	Coordinate social engagements, personal events, and special occasions.
	Book travel, accommodation, transportation, and leisure activities for the executive and family.
	Assist with personal shopping, gift sourcing, and other lifestyle-related requests.
	Research and recommend products, services, and vendors as needed.

	Create and maintain systems that improve household organization and efficiency.
	Coordinate domestic staff schedules and monitor performance where applicable.
	Manage household service providers, including cleaners, maintenance personnel, utility providers, and contractors.

	Maintain organized records of warranties, receipts, service agreements, and household documentation.

	Coordinate family schedules, school-related activities, extracurricular programs, and appointments.

	Assist with planning birthdays, family celebrations, holidays, and other events.
	Coordinate childcare logistics where required.
	Ensure important family dates and commitments are well organized and communicated.


Administrative Support:


	Handle personal correspondence, forms, and documentation.
	Organize and maintain digital and physical filing systems.
	Prepare reminders, checklists, and weekly schedules for personal commitments.
	Monitor outstanding personal tasks and ensure timely completion.
	Liaise with banks, service providers, schools, and other external parties on personal matters.


Errands &amp; Coordination:


	Run or coordinate personal errands efficiently.
	Arrange deliveries and collections.
	Coordinate vehicle servicing, insurance renewals, registrations, and maintenance schedules.
	Ensure household supplies and personal essentials are adequately stocked.
	Resolve day-to-day personal and household issues promptly.


Planning &amp; Organization:


	Develop systems and routines that reduce administrative workload.
	Maintain task trackers and follow up on outstanding personal action items.
	Anticipate upcoming needs and proactively plan ahead.
	Recommend improvements that enhance organization and efficiency in the executive&#39;s personal life.

	Timely coordination of appointments and personal schedules.
	Efficient management of household operations and vendors.
	Reduction in missed appointments, scheduling conflicts, or overdue tasks.
	Timely completion of errands and personal requests.
	Accuracy and organization of household records and documentation.
	Executive satisfaction with personal support and responsiveness.
	Effective coordination of family logistics and events.
	Improvement in household structure and administrative efficiency.

	Experience supporting busy professionals or high-net-worth individuals is an added advantage.

	Excellent organizational and multitasking skills.
	Strong time management and prioritization abilities.
	High level of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.
	Strong written and verbal communication skills.
	Exceptional attention to detail.
	Resourceful with excellent problem-solving skills.
	Ability to anticipate needs and work proactively.
	Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills.
	Calm and adaptable under changing priorities.
	Good negotiation and vendor management skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.
	Ability to use digital calendars, reminders, and task management tools effectively.
	Work Hours: 8:30am to 6:00pm.
